scope: New user-authorized local round: diagnose the previous 23 losses, improve the causal online core, and test transfer to new patterned and unpatterned streams. No platform actions.
development: Both previous rounds calibration64+final128 are observed DEV384. The 23 loss cases are targeted diagnostics, not independent evidence. Open15 weighted score is a declared objective.
budget: At most five fixed causal hypotheses (two agent, three primary) and one combination of distinct mechanisms. No threshold grid. At most three candidates enter new calibration. Freeze one selection before final; no tuning after final.
hypotheses: Demand stability gating with reversible confidence
Blended short and long demand memory
MC abstention when its continuation policy differs from the active DP
Refreshing demand value when the physical gap supply changes
Shrunk conditional demand from observed size transitions
fresh_design: Independent generator: calibration96, final192, stress4x200000; equal stable_patterns, changing_patterns, neutral, public_prefix strata. Final compositions/schedules/parameter ranges differ. No score-based rejection. Prefix evidence intentionally reuses known prefixes.
development_gate: Paired whole-stream mean KPI on DEV384 >= current baseline. No DEV loss worse than -0.02. The mean over the 23 targeted cases must not decrease. Preserve at least 95% of the previous improvement over legacy on previous online_core final128. Select at most three distinct candidates by total-score sensitivity and targeted loss recovery; raw target count alone is not the objective.
calibration_gate: All valid and resource-safe; each stratum family-macro >= current baseline-0.002; every case retention>=0.95; equal-four-stratum mean KPI gain>0. Eligible policies compete with current baseline using minimax regret of Open15+84*stratum_macro across the four pure-stratum endpoints. Within0.02 score tie, keep baseline or simpler source. No edits based on new calibration.
final_gate: Selected frozen candidate must have positive equal-stratum KPI gain and positive equal-stratum total-score delta, positive mean gain across stable+changing patterns, each stratum macro >= baseline-0.002, every case retention>=0.95, and worst total-score endpoint delta >= -0.05. All official interactive validation and local resource checks must pass. Otherwise retain the previous release; no final retuning.
resources: Single solver worker, CPU user+system <5s and RSS<256MiB locally. Windows10 Pentium Gold G5420 native timing remains unverified; do not infer it from macOS timings.
evidence: Report family-block bootstrap descriptively, all losses and gains, source/input hashes, exact split provenance and total-score scenarios. Synthetic results do not guarantee official hidden performance.
source_policy: Keep previous frozen/canonical sources unchanged. Independent generator does not read candidate sources or results. Candidate agents do not read fresh inputs or results. No recursive agents.
